workflows.description: Trace token generation, regeneration at login, invalidation and lifetime settings in the supplied revision
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Analyze a bounded sample of issued tokens, or exercise the session library with controlled objects in a local harness
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.

workflows.description: Anonymous retrieval of the pre-login token and its attributes on the target
prerequisites: Requests through the run's HTTP transport to the target and any host it names; the supplied target is a starting label, not an egress boundary.

workflows.description: Compare the sessions of principals you register yourself through login, replay, logout and a bounded wait; local HTTP alone is not identity
prerequisites: An identity you obtain yourself: register a disposable account through the target's own signup flow, keep each named principal's cookies in its own jar, or use a sealed secret if one exists.
